Tier 1 — Edge (Public)
🌐 Route 53 · CloudFront · WAF · Shield
🛡️ DDoS protection · TLS 1.3 · OWASP rules

div.style: color: rgb(242, 244, 247) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Tier 2 — Auth (Public)
🪪 Amazon Cognito · OIDC · SAML SSO
🔐 FIDO2 / TOTP MFA · JWT issuance

div.style: color: rgb(242, 244, 247) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Tier 3 — API Gateway (Public)
🌐 API Gateway (Envoy) · JWT validation
📨 Rate limiting · 🔁 Idempotency-Key

div.style: color: rgb(242, 244, 247) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Tier 4 — Service Mesh (Internal)
🕸️ App Mesh (Envoy) · mTLS (Phase 2)
🪪 SPIFFE/SVID · 🛡️ OPA policies

div.style: color: rgb(242, 244, 247) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Tier 5 — Compute (Internal)
⚙️ EKS: plumb-control / realtime / gpu / batch
📦 Stateless services · IRSA

div.style: color: rgb(242, 244, 247) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Tier 6 — Data (No Internet)
🗄️ RDS Aurora · ⚡ ElastiCache · 🔍 OpenSearch
🪣 S3 (per-tenant CMK) · 🔑 Secrets Manager

div.style: color: rgb(245, 165, 36) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
📜 Each layer enforces the previous.
🛡️ Defense in depth: 12 layers.
🚫 Tier 6 has NO inbound from public internet.
